title: Draw Maze Puzzle
description: Trace non-crossing paths connecting every character to their matching goal without collisions—a snappy spatial rush-to-goal brain-teaser.
controls: Drag from each character to their matching destination icon while avoiding obstacles and mid-path collisions.

zh-CN.title: 画线迷宫
zh-CN.description: 魔性烧脑路径规划画线迷宫：为多位角色分别画出通往终点的路线，绕开墙壁障碍且绝不撞车，一气呵成超解压！
zh-CN.controls: 从角色出发拖动连线至对应终点，注意规划先后路线避免互相碰撞即可通关。
